name: Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber
description: This blue-bladed lightsaber was a weapon that had once belonged to Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas, who also owned another blue-bladed lightsaber during his lifetime. Sifo-Dyas carried the lightsaber at the time of his death, and it was abandoned on the desert moon of Oba Diah where it was discovered by Master Plo Koon.
